beats.care: Leave the bike at home. Use Cubbon Park station for Cubbon Road gates and MG Road station for Link Road gates.
beats.what: BMRCL extended metro hours on October 17. The last trains leave Majestic at 1 am and RV Road at 1:30 am.
beats.why: A 7 pm T20 ends late. The traffic police have banned parking on Queens Road, MG Road, Cubbon Road and nearby streets.

cards.body: Whitefield and Bommasandra trains end at midnight. Silk Institute and Madavara end at 12:15 am. Majestic runs until 1 am in all four directions.

cards.body: Paid match parking runs 11 am to 9 pm at St Joseph's Indian High School ground, UB City, Shivajinagar bus stand (first floor), Freedom Park and St Joseph's European Boys' School grounds.
